description: Cloud VPS actions on one server: power_on, shutdown, reboot, power_off, reset, rebuild (image), restore_snapshot / delete_snapshot (imageId), create_snapshot, enable_backups / disable_backups, reset_password, reveal_initial_password, enable_rescue / disable_rescue, set_reverse_dns (ip, name), set_firewall (rules), console, add_ssh_key (publicKey, name) / delete_ssh_key (keyId). Returns a proposal; oma_confirm_tool runs it. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

action.description: What to do; the tool description lists each action.

image.description: rebuild: OS or app image name, e.g. ubuntu-24.04.

name.description: set_reverse_dns hostname (empty resets) or add_ssh_key name.

rules.description: set_firewall: the full rule list (replaces existing rules).

serviceId.description: Cloud VPS service id (not needed for SSH key actions).

name: oma_vps_manage
title: Manage Cloud VPS
